card.name: Auxiliary verbs after subject in labeling
card.fires_on: Short linking words in drug-label sentences, mostly 'been' in 'There have been ... reports', and also 'will' or 'is' right after a drug name. Also fires on odd split points like 'e' in eGFR.

modes.label: There have been reports
modes.description: The word 'been' after 'There have' introducing postmarketing or case reports.
modes.example: 5.7 Hypersensitivity Reactions There have<< been>> postmarketing reports of serious hypersensitivity reactions

modes.label: Verb after drug name
modes.description: A 'will' or 'is' placed right after a brand drug name as subject.
modes.example: It is unknown if NUCALA<< will>> influence a patient’s response against parasitic

modes.label: Partway through names
modes.description: A split inside an abbreviation or brand name.
modes.example: The SIMPONI<< A>>RIA dosage regimen is 2 mg per
